title: Docs: Rename the release notes
description:
Rename the Wireshark release notes to "Wireshark Release Notes". This is
in preparation for adding the Stratoshark release notes and a
captitalized name with spaces looks nicer in the system's file explorer.

commits_data.title: Docs: Rename the release notes
commits_data.message:
Docs: Rename the release notes

Rename the Wireshark release notes source file to "Wireshark_Release_Notes".

This is in preparation for adding the Stratoshark release notes and a
captitalized name with spaces looks nicer in the system's file explorer.

commits_data.title: CMake: Improve support for spaces in generated HTML filenames
commits_data.message:
CMake: Improve support for spaces in generated HTML filenames

Add an option to ASCIIDOCTOR2HTML to convert underscores to spaces. Use
it when generating the docs we ship with our macOS DMGs.
